object.attr: Each permission is part of the privacy promise. The list leaves out background location, because recording runs in a foreground service. INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE exist for map tiles only. Basis: as implemented.
object.description: The app shall limit the declared Android permissions to ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, ACCESS_COARSE_LOCATION, FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_LOCATION, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_CONNECTED_DEVICE, BLUETOOTH_SCAN, BLUETOOTH_CONNECT, BLUETOOTH, BLUETOOTH_ADMIN, POST_NOTIFICATIONS, ACTIVITY_RECOGNITION, WAKE_LOCK, INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE.
